notes: Planning estimates, not measurements. Ingredient units: 100 g unless specified below; raw meat weights and dry grains. Ribs use 397 g edible meat and sauce per 600 g bone-in package; this yield is an assumption.

Label units: egg one large; tortilla one 61 g; bread two slices; oil/mayo/salt one teaspoon; meatballs 85 g; pasta 85 g; ribs 140 g edible; sauce 125 mL; dumplings four pieces (96 g) WITH 15 mL included dipping sauce; curry 18 g.

Vegetable size assumptions: zucchini 200 g, half orange bell pepper 75 g edible (170 g whole pepper; red sweet pepper nutrient profile retained as a proxy), Roma 120 g. Meatballs average 907/60 g each: three in meal 5 per half-week. Shrimp reference is the actual 50 kcal/100 g package, not generic cooked shrimp.

Oil: thighs 1/2 tsp, potatoes 1/4, shrimp 1, salmon 1/4, mushrooms 1/4, spinach 1/2, ground chicken 1, fried eggs 1 tsp per half-week. Salt: thighs 1/8 tsp, potatoes 1/16, salmon 1/16. Dry spices not quantified; no soy sauce or stock powder in this version.

EPA+DHA uses fish composition proxies. Missing calcium/iron/potassium/vitamin/iodine values in the revised main meals have not been filled from the retired plan. They remain pending instead of reporting stale totals.

Great Value Chicken & Vegetable Potstickers 1.13 kg: verified Walmart nutrition image, 200 kcal / 4 dumplings (96 g) WITH 15 mL sauce. Meal 7 uses seven pieces (168 g) plus 26.25 mL sauce; sauce is included in the nutrition figures. No sweet potatoes or their oil/salt. Shopping cost assumes net package includes sauce and sauce density 1 g/mL; 388.5 g combined product used weekly.

Balanced portions: rice 35 g dry, pasta 60 g dry, potatoes 170 g raw, noodles 45 g dry. Boiled eggs in meals 1, 5 and 6. Shrimp 170 g raw per half-week, cooked together with 20 g panko and split equally between meals 2 and 6 (85 g raw equivalent each); one 340 g bag of shrimp weekly.

Haddock: High Liner Pan-Sear Selects Roasted Garlic & Herbs, 500 g / four fillets. Manufacturer nutrition per about one fillet (127 g label serving): 170 kcal, protein 18 g, carbohydrate 11 g, fat 6 g, saturated fat 0.5 g, trans fat 0 g, fibre 1 g, sugar 0 g, sodium 410 mg, cholesterol 55 mg. Two fillets weekly; one box every two weeks. Manufacturer figures take precedence over inconsistent retailer copy. EPA+DHA provisionally estimated at 0.16 g per fillet by scaling the original Traditional fish proxy by protein (0.15 x 18/17); not measured. Label total omega-3 is 0.7 g and includes canola oil, so is not treated as EPA+DHA. Use the actual package label if it differs.

Clover Leaf Low Sodium Flaked Light Tuna in Water, two 170 g cans weekly. Manufacturer label unit is half a can drained (55 g); two units (one full can drained, 110 g) in each sandwich; no tuna in the wraps. Chipotle mayonnaise is 2.5 tsp per wrap and 2 tsp per sandwich. Tuna label total omega-3 0.2 g per half-can is used as an EPA+DHA approximation, not a separately measured EPA+DHA value. Little Yellows potatoes use the Canadian label per 110 g; 680 g bag every two weeks. Six meatballs weekly, 60-piece bag every ten weeks.

Chickpeas: Great Value Chick Peas 540 mL, one can weekly, drained and split equally between the two wraps. Planning yield 340 g drained per can (170 g per wrap), not measured. Retains the prior generic canned drained chickpea estimate per 100 g: 139 kcal, protein 7.05 g, carbohydrate 22.5 g, fat 2.77 g, saturated fat 0.27 g, fibre 6.4 g, sugar 4 g, sodium 240 mg; not a verified product-label analysis. Actual drained weight may differ.
